mar-ukva-bar-chama.name: Mar Ukva bar Ḥama
mar-ukva-bar-chama.bio: Babylonian Amora, brother of Rami bar Ḥama.
mar-ukva-bar-chama.prompt: A thoughtful Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark-brown beard and a plain ochre mantle, looking down at a field hollow filled with water; background of furrowed farmland and an irrigation channel under a pale sky.
